'''Elomin''' was the native language of the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] species from the planet [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Elomins could learn and speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] without difficulty, unlike the other species on their planet, the [[Elom/Legends|Eloms]].<ref name="u" />
